What buyers can specify

One packaging program, reviewed from paper to carton

01

Material fit

Paper, grease resistance, release, coating or treatment are discussed against the food and use conditions.

02

Custom printing

Artwork, colors, print coverage and low-odor ink options are reviewed before a production sample is approved.

03

Format conversion

Slitting, sheets, perforation, die-cutting, forming and bag making can be coordinated for the selected product.

04

Buyer evidence

Available food-contact, PFAS, sourcing and management documents are matched to scope—not used as blanket claims.
